description.B4-019: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
description.B4-025: The fur covering this Pokémon's body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.
description.B4-042: It's said that Oshawott learned to maintain its scalchop with riverbed stones by mimicking humans it saw using whetstones.
description.B4-043: Dewott has a studious and stern personality. It masters the use of its scalchops through dedicated, repeated training.
description.B4-044: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.
description.B4-046: It supports the water bubble that envelops its head with three of its legs. Sometimes it secretly swaps which legs are holding up the bubble.
description.B4-047: It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles will get torn apart by Araquanid's gnashing jaws.
description.B4-048: When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around sparkles brilliantly.
description.B4-063: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.
description.B4-070: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.
description.B4-078: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.
description.B4-086: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.
description.B4-089: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.
description.B4-090: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.
description.B4-091: When two of these Pokémon's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.
description.B4-093: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.
description.B4-094: Once it's caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a sign, and its whole pack moves out.
description.B4-095: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.
description.B4-096: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.
description.B4-097: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
description.B4-098: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
description.B4-099: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.
description.B4-101: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.
description.B4-102: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.
description.B4-104: Since the feathers that it sheds are thin and sharp, people apparently once used them as swords.
description.B4-106: All its cells are magnets. It communicates with others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces from its body.
description.B4-112: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.
description.B4-121: Noibat can change the frequency of its sound waves at will, and it generates ultrasonic waves of up to 200,000 hertz.
description.B4-122: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.
description.B4-125: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.
description.B4-132: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.
description.B4-136: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can't make its belly pattern disappear, however.
description.B4-140: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.
description.B4-161: The fur covering this Pokémon's body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.
description.B4-163: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.
description.B4-169: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.
description.B4-171: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.
description.B4-172: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
description.B4-173: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.
description.B4-176: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.
description.B4-179: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.
description.B4-204: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.
description.B4-205: When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.
description.B4-206: It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.
description.B4-207: Swampert's arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down Swampert's foes. This Pokémon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
description.B4-209: This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its body to create noises.
description.B4-212: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.
description.B4-215: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it's time to change formation.
description.B4-218: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

value.name: Stick and Absorb
value.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

value.name: Burning Tail
value.effect: Discard a Fire Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

value.name: Disaster Volt
value.effect: Discard a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

value.name: Extrasensory
value.effect: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 40 more damage.

value.name: Mind Bend
value.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

value.name: Fickle Beam
value.effect: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 100 more damage.

value.name: Energy Blender
value.effect: You may move any amount of Energy from your Pokémon in play to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

value.name: Samesies Slap
value.effect: If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have 1 or more of the same type of Energy attached, this attack does 30 more damage.

value.name: Buddy Spark
value.effect: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

value.name: Surprise Attack
value.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

value.name: Binding Snow
value.effect: During your opponent's next turn, they can't take any Energy from their Energy Zone to attach to their Active Pokémon.

value.name: Dual Customization
value.effect: This Pokémon may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached to it.

value.name: Dig Up
value.effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put 2 random Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.

B4-145.value: Flip a coin. If heads, put a random Item card from your deck into your hand.

B4-149.value: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to the Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed.)

B4-151.value: During this turn, 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen 1 more time for the Draco Meteor attack used by your Pokémon.

B4-191.value: During this turn, 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen 1 more time for the Draco Meteor attack used by your Pokémon.
